title: 第十二章 势在必得
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
因为现在肉类这种东西，对于大部分领主而言，获取的难度都是比其他素材要稍微高一些的。

    所以在玩家之间进行交易的时候，自然而然的，肉类的交易价格，也会比其他的素材要更高一些。

    虽然在进行回收的时候，系统这边给出的肉类的回收价格反而会更低，比其他的材料要更低一点，但在玩家端的交易，却不是这么回事。

    玩家之间的资源流通，完全就呈现出另一幅景象，反而是肉类的价格更高一些。

    不过，秦天大概是有一些判断的，系统给出相对较低一些的回收价，其实在某种程度上也能说明问题。

    随着之后，玩家的发展越来越靠前，食物的问题肯定是会得到解决的。

    领主加上自己的领民，一共能消耗的食物其实也是比较有限的，而之后在建造各类设施、强化自己领地的时候，需要的材料数量反而会更加庞大。

    到那个时候，这种情况估计会反过来。

    而对他来说，肉类的产出太过简单，所以现在它的售卖价格相比起其他人来讲，是相当实惠的。

    这也就直接导致，他的这些材料摆上去，还根本没过多久，就已经有很多人在疯狂购买。

    而他的领主币的余额，也是在以肉眼可见的速度蹭蹭上涨！

    这样的情况，秦天并不意外。

    同时他也没有浪费什么时间，立刻就在摊位上开始翻找自己想要购买的东西。

    元素石。

    他现在有土系，也有火系。

    接下来就只差金系木系，水系了。

    他寻找元素石，发现确实有，价格虽然不低，但完全在可接受的范围内，也绝对算不上高。

    毕竟现在只是产量较少，很多人都还处在要生存的阶段，连生存的问题都还没解决，自然是不清楚会有一些特定建筑要用到这些元素石。

    所以他们现在能摆出来的价格，说白了，那也只是他们自己内心较为接受的价格而已。

    毕竟这玩意儿，产量实在太过稀少，成交的例子也是少到几乎没有，绝大部分人对于这玩意儿都是不存在什么需求的。

    所以他们在售卖的时候，也只能大概按照自己的心理价位来进行评判。

    现在这些价格，对于想要快点将建筑给修缮出来的秦天而言，自然是可以接受的。

    他立刻就直接买了两颗！

    这下就只剩下最后一颗水系元素石。

    他在摊位上简单筛选搜索，立刻就找到了水系元素石。

    而且，在看到这东西的时候，就连秦天也松了口气，心中暗自觉得有些庆幸。
content_en:
Because meat is now slightly more difficult for most lords to obtain than other materials.

    Therefore, when trading between players, it is natural that the transaction price of meat will be higher than other materials.

    Although when recycling, the recycling price of meat given by the system will be lower, slightly lower than other materials, but the transaction on the player side is not the same.

    The circulation of resources between players presents a completely different picture. On the contrary, the price of meat is higher.

    However, Qin Tian probably had some judgment, and the system gave a relatively low recycling price, which actually explained the problem to a certain extent.

    As players develop further and further in the future, the food problem will definitely be solved.

    The total amount of food that a lord and his subjects can consume is actually relatively limited. However, later on, when building various facilities and strengthening his territory, the amount of materials required will be even greater.

    By that time, the situation is expected to be reversed.

    For him, the production of meat is too simple, so its current selling price is quite affordable compared to others.

    This directly led to the fact that not long after he put these materials up, many people were already buying them like crazy.

    And the balance of his lord coins is also rising at a speed visible to the naked eye!

    Qin Tian was not surprised by this situation.

    At the same time, he didn't waste any time and immediately started rummaging through the stalls for what he wanted to buy.

    Elemental stone.

    He now has earth and fire elements.

    Next, the only remaining elements are the gold, wood, and water elements.

    He looked for elemental stones and found that they did exist. Although the price was not low, it was completely within the acceptable range and definitely not high.

    After all, the output is only low now, and many people are still in the stage of survival. Even the problem of survival has not been solved. Naturally, it is not clear that some specific buildings will use these elemental stones.

    So the price they can put out now, to put it bluntly, is just the price they themselves are more comfortable with.

    After all, the output of this thing is too rare, and there are almost no examples of transactions. Most people have no demand for this thing.

    Therefore, when they sell, they can only judge based on their own psychological price.

    Now these prices are naturally acceptable to Qin Tian who wants to repair the building quickly.

    He immediately bought two!

    Now there is only the last water elemental stone left.

    He briefly sifted through the stalls and found the water element stone immediately.

    Moreover, when seeing this thing, even Qin Tian breathed a sigh of relief and felt a little lucky in his heart.
